title: From Watching to Steering: Enabling Human-Coding Agent Collaboration through Execution Traces
title_zh: 从旁观到驾驭：通过执行轨迹实现人与编程智能体协作

paragraphs.en: 提出Vibetrace交互式轨迹可视化与干预系统，蒸馏技能使SWE-bench输入token减少23%并通过率提升至68%。 Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled coding agents to autonomously perform complex software development tasks, yet their long-running execution remains difficult for users to inspect, understand, and steer. We present Vibetrace, an interactive trace visualization and intervention system for agentic programming built upon OpenCode. Vibetrace introduces a human-agent collaboration paradigm of Observe, Understand, Intervene, and Evolve. It (1) visualizes agent workflows as interactive execution traces for inspecting actions, intermediate states, and failures; (2) enables users to fork execution from prior steps and provide targeted corrections without restarting validated progress; and (3) distills traces and human feedback into reusable skills for continual agent evolution. On SWE-bench Verified, distilled skills reduce input tokens by 23.0% and cost by 15.5%, while improving pass rate from 65.0% to 68.0%. User studies further demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional log-based interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使智能体（coding agents）能够自主执行复杂的软件开发任务，然而其长时间运行的执行过程对用户而言仍然难以检查、理解和干预。 我们提出了Vibetrace，一个基于OpenCode构建的面向智能体编程的交互式轨迹可视化与干预系统。 Vibetrace引入了一种「观察（Observe）、理解（Understand）、干预（Intervene）、演化（Evolve）」的人机智能体协作范式。 它：(1) 将智能体工作流可视化为交互式执行轨迹，以便检查动作、中间状态和失败情况；(2) 支持用户从先前步骤分叉执行并提供针对性纠正，而无需重启已验证的进展；(3) 将轨迹和人类反馈蒸馏为可复用的技能，以实现智能体的持续演化。 在SWE-bench Verified上，蒸馏技能使输入token减少23.0%，成本降低15.5%，同时将通过率从65.0%提升至68.0%。 用户研究进一步表明，与传统的基于日志的交互方式相比，该方法提高了准确性和效率。
